title: Ball Sort Puzzle
seo_title: Ball Sort Puzzle — Play Free Ball Sorting Game Online
meta_desc: Play Ball Sort Puzzle online free. Move colored balls between tubes until each tube holds one color — a classic brain-teasing sorting game.
desc: Ball Sort Puzzle is the tube-sorting classic: colored balls sit stacked in tubes and only the top ball can move. Drop balls onto a matching color or into an empty tube and sort every tube down to a single color.
howto: Click or tap a tube to lift its top ball.
Drop it onto a tube whose top ball matches, or an empty tube.
Only the topmost ball of each tube ever moves.
Complete the level when every tube is uniformly colored.
Levels add more colors and fuller tubes as you progress.
tips: Avoid burying a rare single ball at the bottom of a nearly sorted tube.
Empty tubes are your most valuable resource — spend them reluctantly.
Sort colors you see most of first to free space faster.
